mapper.select: SELECT u.`username`, ui.`nickname`, ui.`avatar_path` AS `avatarUrl`, DATE_FORMAT(u.`create_time`, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `createTime`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `illustration` i WHERE i.`user_id` = u.`id` AND i.`deleted` = 0) AS `illustrationCount`, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.`size`), 0) FROM `illustration` i WHERE i.`user_id` = u.`id`) AS `illustrationStorageBytes`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `manga` m WHERE m.`user_id` = u.`id` AND m.`deleted` = 0) AS `mangaCount`, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(m.`size`), 0) FROM `manga` m WHERE m.`user_id` = u.`id`) AS `mangaStorageBytes`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `game` g WHERE g.`user_id` = u.`id` AND g.`deleted` = 0) AS `gameCount`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `novel` n WHERE n.`user_id` = u.`id` AND n.`deleted` = 0) AS `novelCount`, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(n.`total_words`), 0) FROM `novel` n WHERE n.`user_id` = u.`id` AND n.`deleted` = 0) AS `novelWords` FROM `user` u INNER JOIN `user_info` ui ON ui.`user_id` = u.`id` WHERE u.`id` = #{userId} AND u.`deleted` = 0
